passage.text: This is the timetable for trains to Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ðə ˈtaɪmteɪbəl fər ˈtreɪnz tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: The morning train leaves at 8:30 a.m.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ˈtreɪn ˈliːvz ət ˈeɪt ˈθɜːrti ˌeɪˈɛm.

passage.text: It arrives in Chiang Mai at 7:30 p.m.
passage.reading: ɪt əˈraɪvz ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ət ˈsɛvən ˈθɜːrti ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: The night train leaves at 6 p.m. from Platform 5.
passage.reading: ðə ˈnaɪt ˌtreɪn ˈliːvz ət ˈsɪks ˌpiːˈɛm frəm ˈplætfɔːrm ˈfaɪv.
